On Wed, Jan 13, 2027 at 01:26 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding OakWorks' alert. They are pinned to APAC and reporting high p99s and a non-trivial error rate.

Quick triage: we are seeing elevated token latency and r13/connection errors for several model variants in ap-southeast-1 starting ~01:05 UTC. Metrics show node-level GPU memory pressure on a small subset of the pool plus degraded networking to a storage endpoint used for KV cache shards.

Immediate mitigation options (fastest -> slower):
1) Account-scoped region override: switch OakWorks' routing policy to prefer eu-central-1 (or us-east-1) for 100% of new sessions. This is a configuration toggle — low risk, immediate. We can enable per-account logging to preserve audit and collect KV cache miss metrics.
2) Gradual traffic steer (canary): route 20% -> eu-central-1, monitor 15m, then increase. Safer for correctness.
3) Force redeploy of affected nodes in ap-southeast-1 (longer, risky during active surge).

I can push the account override now if leadership approves. There will be temporary increase in tail latency for long-context keys due to KV cache cold starts, but overall p99 should drop significantly and errors will stop. Estimate 6–12% transient cost increase on raw egress for routes going to eu.

I'll attach a short metric dump to the ticket (region_metrics_snaps.pdf).

Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
